LSN
Description
These commands are used to interact the Large-Scale NAT (LSN) system
on the BIG-IP. LSN is also referred to as Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT).
Command List
LSN::inbound-entry
- creates and
gets the inbound mapping for a translation address, translation
port and protocol
LSN::address
- Set or override translation
address.
LSN::disable
- Disable LSN translation.
LSN::inbound
- Disable inbound connections
to translation address/port.
LSN::persistence
- Set translation
selection mode and persistence timeout.
LSN::persistence-entry
- Create
or lookup translation address.
LSN::pool
- Specify LSN pool for current
connection.
LSN::port
- Set or override translation port.
